title: Court walls for multiple dwellings.
officialText:
All walls enclosing courts of multiple dwellings shall be of light colored
materials or shall be painted a light color.
Exceptions:
1. Outer courts that open to a street.
2. Courts that exceed the minimum dimension set forth in the New York City Zoning Resolution by at least 50 percent.
